local colorCorrection = Lighting:FindFirstChild("ExtremeDesaturation") or Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
colorCorrection.Name = "ExtremeDesaturation"
colorCorrection.Parent = Lighting

colorCorrection.Saturation = 1.3 -- 0 > Normal saturation level
colorCorrection.Enabled = true
